kjv: delicate, delight, pleasure. See also H1040 (בֵּית עֵדֶן).

occurrences.text: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.

Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
